title: Can't use Screen constants as DisplayServer.ScreenGetScale parameters in C#
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in 4.7.2.stable.mono.

### System information

Godot v4.7.2.stable.mono - Ubuntu 24.04.4 LTS 24.04 on Wayland - Wayland display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Mobile) - integrated Intel(R) Iris(R) Xe Graphics (ADL GT2) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-1240P (16 threads) - 46.75 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

[DisplayServer.ScreenGetScale](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_displayserver.html#class-displayserver-method-screen-get-scale) has an integer parameter named `screen`. The documentation states:

> One of the following constants can be used as `screen`: [SCREEN_OF_MAIN_WINDOW](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_displayserver.html#class-displayserver-constant-screen-of-main-window), [SCREEN_PRIMARY](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_displayserver.html#class-displayserver-constant-screen-primary), [SCREEN_WITH_MOUSE_FOCUS](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_displayserver.html#class-displayserver-constant-screen-with-mouse-focus), or [SCREEN_WITH_KEYBOARD_FOCUS](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_displayserver.html#class-displayserver-constant-screen-with-keyboard-focus).

However, all the constants mentioned are `long`s; this means that C# won't compile if those constants are used.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Make a C# class in a project. 
2. Add the following line anywhere that you would expect C# code using Godot code to work:
    `var scale = DisplayServer.ScreenGetScale(DisplayServer.ScreenOfMainWindow);`
3. Feel free to replace the constant with any others mentioned in the issue.
4. Observe that it doesn't compile

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Making a whole new Godot project seems like overkill in this instance! But I will do it if someone requests it.
